analyst.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation is a pure refining-margin (GRM) driven PSU refiner whose latest quarter's large profit swing reflects both a cyclically elevated refining margin and a Rs 385 crore one-time gain from a retrospective price revision — not a repeatable improvement in the underlying business. The stock's cheap ~6x earnings multiple correctly reflects this cyclicality rather than representing an overlooked bargain. We rate it a Hold.
